title: pilea caulescens
intro: Pilea caulescens, commonly known as the 'False Daisy' or 'Pilea', is a flowering plant species native to tropical Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Pilea caulescens include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can be used to treat various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
